channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Colbert amps row with CBS over blocked interview with Democrat candidate
item.description: CBS late-night host Stephen Colbert shot back at his network Tuesday over its handling of his interview with Democratic U.S. Senate candidate James Talarico of Texas.

item.title: Zuckerberg defends Instagram in landmark tech addiction trial
item.description: LOS ANGELES >> In a crowded courtroom today, a lawyer drew a picture of a frowning stick figure and projected it on a screen in front of Mark Zuckerberg, Meta’s CEO.

item.title: Firefighters extinguish blaze at 2-story Diamond Head home
item.description: Honolulu firefighters extinguished a blaze at a two-story home in the Diamond Head neighborhood early this morning that resulted in a partial roof collapse. No injuries were reported.

item.title: Super Bowl champs Seattle Seahawks being put up for sale
item.description: SEATTLE >> The Seattle Seahawks officially announced Wednesday morning that the Paul G. Allen estate is beginning the process of putting the team up for sale.

item.title: FDA reverses course, will review Moderna’s flu vaccine application
item.description: Moderna said today the Food and Drug Administration changed course and will review an amended application for its new flu vaccine, a week after rejecting the original submission and fueling drugmaker and investor concerns over policy changes at the agency under President Donald Trump.

item.title: Gold surges over 2% on geopolitical jitters
item.description: Gold rose more than 2% today, as investors assessed simmering geopolitical risks, even as minutes from the U.S. Federal Reserve’s January meeting showed officials divided over whether interest rates may need to be hiked again or should remain on hold.

item.title: Woman, 32, arrested in Waianae armed robbery; 2 suspects at large
item.description: Honolulu police arrested a 32-year-old woman today after two masked gunmen allegedly robbed a worker at gunpoint in Waianae, leading to a police pursuit and the recovery of multiple stolen vehicles.

item.title: U.S. military moves into place for possible strikes in Iran
item.description: The rapid buildup of U.S. forces in the Middle East has progressed to the point that President Donald Trump has the option to take military action against Iran as soon as this weekend, administration and Pentagon officials said, leaving the White House with high stakes choices about pursuing diplomacy or war.

item.title: Hawaii island police seek 3 ‘armed and dangerous’ suspects
item.description: Hawaii island police are seeking the public’s help to locate three people who are wanted on active arrest warrants and “should be considered armed and dangerous.”

item.title: Police arrest 2 teens in connection with Kapolei shooting
item.description: A 19-year-old man and a 16-year-old girl were arrested today in connection with the Sunday shooting of two contractors from the mainland in front of a Taco Bell in Kapolei, police said.
